text:
ana: Heads-up: I'm planning to enable feature flag `cb_optimizer_v2` tomorrow at 08:00 PT for a small traffic slice (~2%). Goal: combine prefix caching + adaptive batching to cut per-token GPU cost ~10-15%. Quick ask: confirm guardrails + rollback plan.

mike: What's the exact canary slice? 2% across all customers or a region-specific slice?

ana: 2% global by user_id hash (hash(user_id) % 50 == 0). We'll exclude enterprise tenants (org_tier == \"enterprise\") from the rule.

sophia: Perf targets / guardrails?

ana: Targets: no >5% increase in p99 latency, error rate increase <0.5% absolute, throughput stable. If any threshold breaches for 3 consecutive 10m windows we'll auto-rollback. We'll track p50/p95/p99 + `cb.fallback_count`.

raj: Telemetry ready? Need flags emitted and a sanity metric for KV cache hit rate + avg batch size.

ana: Telemetry added: metrics `cb.cache_hit`, `cb.batch_avg_size`, `cb.fallback_count`. Logs include flag context. I ran a smoke CI; see command to toggle below.

ana: Flag toggle (ops):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"flag":"cb_optimizer_v2","enabled":true,"rules":"hash(user_id) % 50 == 0 && org_tier != \"enterprise\""}'
```

deploy-bot: [CI] canary-smoke: PASS — unit + integration green; e2e smoke executed. Logs: https://ci.example/176/report

mike: Any offline eval on cost/quality?

ana: Ran offline eval on 10k production-like prompts: token cost down 12%, QA/regression check within noise (no systematic regressions). Pasted a short sample diff in the docs link: https://docs.internal/cache-batch/eval-177

sophia: Rollback steps? Who does manual rollback and how does infra auto-detect?

ana: Manual: flip flag off in LaunchDarkly or hit the ops toggle above. Automated: traffic-router watches `alert_cb_p99_increase` / `cb.fallback_count` and will revert routing to `cb_optimizer_v1` if breach conditions met. Infra KILL switch exists: `rds.disable_cb_optimizer` (for catastrophic network/oom).

sam-oncall: @ana please add me as watcher. If error_rate > 1% I'll escalate.

ana: Added sam-oncall as watcher and pinned a grafana panel for the canary metrics. Alert `alert_cb_p99_increase` created.

raj: Load tests? Yesterday's staging run looked okay but confirm resource pressure — GPU mem, queue backlog?

ana: Staging 100 qps x 30m: no GPU OOM, memory +3% vs baseline, queue latency +~6ms. We'll optionally do a 10min 500 qps burst during the canary ramp to validate saturation behavior.

mike: I'll do a quick CR review on the batching change. @sophia can you own the first 30m watch?

sophia: Happy to. I'll monitor tail latency, `cb.fallback_count`, and tail retries.

ana: Thanks — schedule set for 08:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post status at +10m and +40m. :thumbsup:

mike: LGTM from me.

raj: Looks good. One nit: please include a short troubleshooting checklist in the ops doc (how to interpret `cb.batch_avg_size` drops vs cache hits).

ana: Will add checklist to the runbook tonight.
